profile.headline: engineering @ zillow, aws
profile.summary:
Fortunate to be known as waejay — lifetime learner on the endless pursuit of emotionally moving humanity and reaching my human potential.

I am very good at understanding people, which helps when it comes to building things that solve people's problems. I also find work very fun, and hope to make it fun for the people around me.

Outside of software engineering, I have lots of hobbies! Training for Hyrox/LA Marathon, reading, fixing my golf slices, playing pickleball, attempting to achieve wok hei, and being with the people who matter (including my 11-year-old Corgi)!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Geospatial
positions.description: When you buy a home, you're also buying the location, and information surrounding a home is critical — whether it be what schools are nearby for your kids, points of interests like parks for you to run at, commute times so you aren't stuck in traffic for 1+ hours, and so much more.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II - County Data
positions.description:
Working with brilliant engineers, product managers, and internal stakeholders to build a comprehensive data pipeline to collect, process, & use public data directly sourced from 3000+ counties across the United States. 

I also focus on upholding documentation, thorough testing, making our app's UX really nice and fun to use, and spicing up my team's work day with funny GIFs from time to time.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Independently built a 0→1 end-to-end HIPAA-compliant AI scribe that allowed clinicians to record their psychiatric sessions and generate a custom summarized chart, saving several hours of documentation. 

Originally built for my then-girlfriend, then piloted with a psychiatry friend (that cleared their weekends to do the things they love) and sunseted due to competing priorities (my then-girlfriend is now my fiance, if that helps 😉).

Self-hosted Faster-Whisper (GPU, AWS ECS/EC2) for speech-to-text, plus a two-pass LLM pipeline (structured extraction → personalized note rendering) using GPT-5.4-mini, with eval-driven model selection, all served through Next.js/FastAPI web app. Optimized for speed & simplicity rather than overengineering, though I certainly had many ideas to scale.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Ownership · Start-up Ventures · Next.js · FastAPI · Large Language Models (LLM) · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.description: Left due to Amazon RTO becoming a thing after COVID and I wanted to move back close to my family.

positions.title: Asian New Year Director
